families.label: Bank Fees
families.description: Monthly service charges, overdraft fees, wire fees and other bank-imposed costs.

families.label: Bank Interest Income
families.description: Interest earned on operating bank accounts or cash equivalents.

families.label: Card Processing Fees
families.description: Stripe, PayPal, Square, and other card network fees.

families.label: Merchant Settlements
families.description: Net payouts from payment processors (gross revenue minus fees).

families.label: Customer Refund
families.description: Refunds or chargebacks issued to customers.

families.label: Payroll - Net Wages
families.description: Net payroll payouts to employees (paired with accrued payroll liabilities).

families.label: Payroll Taxes & Withholding
families.description: Employer-side payroll tax remittances; employee withholdings clearing.

families.label: Employee Benefits
families.description: Health insurance, retirement contributions, and other benefit providers.

families.label: Rent & Lease
families.description: Office rent, warehouse leases, coworking spaces.

families.label: Utilities
families.description: Electricity, water, internet, and other utility providers.

families.label: Insurance Premiums
families.description: General liability, workers comp, cyber insurance, etc.

families.label: Software & SaaS
families.description: Recurring SaaS and software licenses (e.g. Slack, Zoom, Adobe).

families.label: Cloud Infrastructure
families.description: AWS, GCP, Azure, and other infrastructure providers.

families.label: Advertising & Marketing
families.description: Paid ads, campaign fees, sponsorships, marketing agencies.

families.label: Meals & Entertainment
families.description: Client meals, team outings, small morale spend.

families.label: Travel - Airfare
families.description: Business flights or airfare bookings.

families.label: Travel - Lodging
families.description: Hotels and other business travel lodging.

families.label: Travel - Ground Transport
families.description: Rideshare, taxis, rail, mileage reimbursements.

families.label: Office Supplies
families.description: General office supplies, printers, small equipment.

families.label: Professional Services
families.description: Consultants, contractors, design agencies, training.

families.label: Legal Services
families.description: Law firms, compliance counsel, corporate filings.

families.label: Accounting & Audit
families.description: CPAs, audit firms, bookkeeping services.

families.label: Loan Principal Payment
families.description: Principal repayment on loans; usually paired with interest expense.

families.label: Loan Interest Expense
families.description: Interest charged on loans, credit lines, and equipment financing.

families.label: Income & Corporate Tax Payments
families.description: Quarterly estimated taxes, annual tax payments.

families.label: Sales/VAT Remittance
families.description: Sales tax, VAT, GST remittances to tax authorities.

families.label: Equipment Purchase (CapEx)
families.description: Capitalized purchases of machinery, vehicles, or large equipment.

families.label: Inventory Purchase
families.description: Inventory buys that feed cost-of-goods-sold.

families.label: Customer Payment (Receivable)
families.description: Collections from customers on outstanding invoices.

families.label: Owner Draw / Distribution
families.description: Distributions to owners, dividends, partner draws.

families.label: Equity Injection
families.description: Capital contributions from investors or owners.

families.label: Transfer Between Accounts
families.description: Transfers between bank accounts / entities; no P&L impact.

families.label: Foreign Exchange Gain/Loss
families.description: FX revaluation entries, realized gains/losses on currency conversion.

families.label: Prepaid Expense
families.description: Advance payments booked to prepaid assets and later amortized.

families.label: Accrual Reversal
families.description: Reverse prior period accruals or deferred revenue balances.
